content:
Some iOS 27 users are affected by an annoying iPhone notification bug. Affected users see a red badge on the Settings app warning them to "Enable iCloud Storage".

However, tapping the warning only takes you to the iCloud storage purchase page, and the warning does not go away even after you dismiss it. The erroneous notification appears even if the user already has plenty of iCloud storage, such as a 2TB family Apple One subscription.

While Apple sometimes uses the Settings app to promote offers (such as Apple TV trials) or remind users about AppleCare coverage, this particular notification appears to be simply a bug rather than a sneaky way to push iCloud add-on promotions.

The notification appears on devices running iOS 27 and iOS 27.2 release versions, as well as iOS 26.7.

Some users have reported that signing out of the Apple Account on the device and signing back in makes the warning go away. But hopefully Apple will fix this on the backend soon as well.

Update: Apple Support advises users to sign out of and back into the "Media & Purchases" account on the device. Go to Settings -> [Your Name] -> Media & Purchases -> Sign Out, then sign back in.
